description.ja: ポリポッドボールをＭＧシリーズで商品化！
description.en: Commercialize polypod balls in the MG series!

description.ja: ●　脚部パーツを新規造形で再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the leg parts with new modeling!

description.ja: 陸上での運用を想定して作られた脚部パーツを新規造形で再現。シリンダー部は伸縮し、
description.en: The leg parts, which were created with the assumption of operation on land, are reproduced with new modeling. The cylinder part expands and contracts,

description.ja: 連動してスライドギミックが可動するＭＧならでのは仕様に。
description.en: It is a specification unique to MG that the slide gimmick moves in conjunction with each other.

description.ja: ●　異素材が放つメカニカル感！
description.en: ● Mechanical feel from different materials!

description.ja: 腕部には金属製のシリンダーパーツを採用。さらに腕先にはリード線を用いて、リアルな質感を再現。
description.en: Metal cylinder parts are used for the arms. Furthermore, lead wires are used at the ends of the arms to reproduce a realistic texture.

description.ja: また、四脚での安定した自立が可能。
description.en: It is also possible to stably stand on its own on four legs.

description.ja: ●　フレキシブルかつ表情豊かなポージングが可能！
description.en: ● Flexible and expressive poses are possible!

description.ja: 複数の関節により、フレキシブルな可動、幅広いポージングを再現可能。
description.en: Multiple joints allow for flexible movement and a wide range of poses.

description.ja: さらに特徴的なサブアームは展開可動式。
description.en: Furthermore, the distinctive sub-arm is expandable and movable.
